description: This file contains the implementation of a function for a Transport Layer Security (TLS) server object, specifically handling timer invocation to generate alerts on timeout events. It defines the function TlsHsoServerStateTimerInvoke, which is called when a state timer fires, causing the generation of a TLS alert via a callback interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoServerStateTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles the timer event in the TLS server object, triggering an alert with a fatal level and timeout description via the TLS CBC interface.
